title: Implement ClaudeHarness adapter for swappable vendor harnesses

story.as_a: Infrastructure engineer maintaining the agentic workflow orchestration system
story.i_want: Implement a ClaudeHarness class that implements the common.harness.Harness protocol and is swappable with DevinHarness via environment variable indirection
story.so_that: The Claude CLI can be used as an alternative harness provider for skill activities, providing identical interface and behavior parity with DevinHarness

journey.before: Currently only Devin harness is available for skill-activity invocations; adding a second harness provider requires code changes to multiple modules and every skill config file
journey.during: Configure Claude as an alternative harness via <WORKFLOW>_HARNESS environment variable; implement protocol-compliant adapter; verify feature parity with Devin behavior
journey.after: Multiple harness providers (Devin, Claude) are available and swappable at runtime via environment variable; workflows can run with either CLI without code changes; trajectory telemetry and usage metrics are captured consistently regardless of harness

capability_breakdown.core_action: Implement a Claude CLI harness adapter (src/common/claude_harness.py) that conforms to the common.harness.Harness protocol, enabling drop-in replacement of DevinHarness via environment variable indirection
inputs: Skill prompt text (from SkillActivity.build_prompt()) passed as final positional argument after --
Claude harness configuration block (from *.config.json under 'claude' namespace) with optional model and permission_mode fields
Process environment including ANTHROPIC_API_KEY or CLAUDE_CODE_OAUTH_TOKEN for authentication
Optional Activity logging context (Cadence-specific) from workflow_logger for determining trajectory storage mode
outputs: HarnessResult containing: exit_code (int), stdout (text or NDJSON), stderr (text), and optional HarnessUsage telemetry (prompt_tokens, completion_tokens, cached_tokens, cost_usd)
NDJSON trajectory file written to activity artifact directory (durable) when Activity context exists, containing system/init, assistant/user/tool_result events, and terminal result event
Structured logging events: SelectClaudeTelemetrySource (before invocation), StartClaudeInvocation, CompleteClaudeInvocation (after)
Per-invocation Claude-specific log file (claude.log) with debug-level stdout/stderr capture
state_changes: Trajectory artifact written to get_activity_artifact_dir()/claude-trajectory.jsonl when Activity context active, retained for audit
Activity log populated with harness execution metadata: skill name, model, permission_mode, exit_code, duration, usage availability boolean
Claude-specific log file created in activity artifact directory with DEBUG-level content
Config structure supports both 'devin' and 'claude' namespaces in same file without conflict

ui: No UI changes required - this is backend harness infrastructure
api: common.harness.Harness protocol (no changes - protocol is structural)
No external API changes - harness interface is internal
database: No database schema changes required - harness uses existing artifact/log storage via workflow_logger
external_services: Claude CLI (claude -p --output-format stream-json --verbose ...) invoked as subprocess
Anthropic authentication (ANTHROPIC_API_KEY or CLAUDE_CODE_OAUTH_TOKEN) must be pre-configured in environment
No new external services - uses Claude CLI only

acceptance_criteria.criterion: ClaudeHarness implements Harness protocol with correct method signature
acceptance_criteria.gherkin: Given a ClaudeHarness instance When run(prompt, *, cwd=path, config=mapping) is called Then it returns HarnessResult with exit_code, stdout, stderr, and usage fields matching the protocol
acceptance_criteria.jtbd: Conform to the Harness interface contract

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Zero-argument constructor enables environment-variable instantiation
acceptance_criteria.gherkin: Given <WORKFLOW>_HARNESS env var set to module:ClaudeHarness When harness_instance.py loads and calls cls() Then ClaudeHarness() is successfully instantiated without arguments
acceptance_criteria.jtbd: Enable harness swapping via environment variable

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Subprocess invocation uses 'claude -p --output-format stream-json --verbose' with explicit --permission-mode and --model
acceptance_criteria.gherkin: Given a skill activity invocation When ClaudeHarness.run() is called Then subprocess.run(['claude', '-p', '--permission-mode', mode, '--model', model, '--output-format', 'stream-json', '--verbose', '--', prompt], cwd=cwd, capture_output=True, text=True) is executed
acceptance_criteria.jtbd: Invoke Claude CLI in non-interactive mode with explicit configuration

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Config namespace isolation: reads only 'claude' namespace, ignores 'devin' and other namespaces
acceptance_criteria.gherkin: Given a config dict with 'claude' and 'devin' namespaces When ClaudeHarnessConfig.from_mapping() is called Then only 'claude' keys are parsed, 'devin' is ignored, no error is raised, and MappingProxyType configs are accepted
acceptance_criteria.jtbd: Support both harness providers in a single config file during migration

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Permission modes validated against Claude-specific supported set
acceptance_criteria.gherkin: Given an invalid permission_mode When ClaudeHarnessConfig.from_mapping() is called Then error is raised with error_category='invalid_value: claude.permission_mode'; valid modes are {default, acceptEdits, plan, auto, dontAsk, bypassPermissions}
acceptance_criteria.jtbd: Enforce least-privilege permission defaults

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Default permission mode is secure: 'dontAsk' (fail-closed, never prompts)
acceptance_criteria.gherkin: Given a config without permission_mode When ClaudeHarnessConfig.from_mapping() is called Then permission_mode defaults to 'dontAsk' (no interactive approval possible)
acceptance_criteria.jtbd: Apply secure defaults that fail closed

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Model field validated: rejects non-string or blank values
acceptance_criteria.gherkin: Given a config with non-string, blank, or missing model When ClaudeHarnessConfig.from_mapping() is called Then validation succeeds with explicit model value, or error_category='invalid_value: claude.model' is raised
acceptance_criteria.jtbd: Prevent invalid model configuration

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Captures NDJSON stream from --output-format stream-json --verbose
acceptance_criteria.gherkin: Given claude -p --output-format stream-json --verbose invocation When subprocess completes Then stdout contains NDJSON lines: system/init event, alternating assistant/user/tool_result events, and terminal result event
acceptance_criteria.jtbd: Capture full execution trajectory for audit and analysis

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Trajectory written to durable artifact directory when Activity context exists
acceptance_criteria.gherkin: Given an Activity logging context active When run() completes Then trajectory NDJSON is written to get_activity_artifact_dir()/claude-trajectory.jsonl and retained indefinitely
acceptance_criteria.jtbd: Retain execution trajectory for audit

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Trajectory parsed then deleted when no Activity context exists
acceptance_criteria.gherkin: Given no Activity logging context When run() completes Then trajectory is written to tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(), parsed for usage, deleted before returning, and exit_code/stdout/stderr are preserved
acceptance_criteria.jtbd: Avoid accumulating temporary trajectory files

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Usage metrics extracted from terminal 'result' event only, best-effort parsing
acceptance_criteria.gherkin: Given NDJSON stream with terminal result event When read_claude_usage_result() parses stream Then only the final result event's usage fields are extracted; no summing or per-turn processing; missing/malformed/truncated stream returns usage=None with sanitized error_category, no exception raised
acceptance_criteria.jtbd: Extract cost and token metrics from execution

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Only four HarnessUsage fields normalized: prompt_tokens, completion_tokens, cached_tokens, cost_usd
acceptance_criteria.gherkin: Given result event with additional fields When HarnessUsage is constructed Then only the four named fields are populated; booleans presented as token counts are rejected; unknown fields are dropped; all field values use shared _token()/_cost() coercion helpers
acceptance_criteria.jtbd: Extract standardized cost metrics

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Process result passed through unchanged regardless of telemetry outcome
acceptance_criteria.gherkin: Given non-zero exit, truncated trajectory, malformed JSON, or missing result event When run() returns Then exit_code, stdout, stderr are unchanged from subprocess; usage is None; no exception is raised; telemetry failure is logged as warning only
acceptance_criteria.jtbd: Preserve process result independently from telemetry extraction

acceptance_criteria.criterion: OSError on process launch converted to RuntimeError('claude_launch_failed')
acceptance_criteria.gherkin: Given claude binary not found, permission denied, or other OSError When subprocess.run() raises OSError Then RuntimeError('claude_launch_failed') is raised after logging error_category=claude_launch_failed to both loggers
acceptance_criteria.jtbd: Detect and report harness launch failures

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Logging emits sanitized metadata without leaking sensitive content
acceptance_criteria.gherkin: Given a complete invocation When logs are written Then storage mode, exit code, duration, usage-availability boolean are logged at INFO level; prompt text, raw NDJSON, tool arguments are never logged at INFO level; raw output logged at DEBUG level only to harness-specific logger
acceptance_criteria.jtbd: Maintain audit trail without exposing sensitive content

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Logging emits same event taxonomy as DevinHarness
acceptance_criteria.gherkin: Given a harness invocation When logging occurs Then SelectClaudeTelemetrySource event emitted before invocation (storage mode), StartClaudeInvocation event emitted with skill_name/model/permission_mode, CompleteClaudeInvocation event emitted with exit_code/duration/usage_available
acceptance_criteria.jtbd: Enable consistent log parsing and analysis across harness types

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Shared coercion helpers extracted to vendor-neutral module
acceptance_criteria.gherkin: Given _token() and _cost() functions When both DevinHarness and ClaudeHarness parse usage Then both import from common/harness_usage.py; no duplication of boolean-rejection or type-coercion logic
acceptance_criteria.jtbd: Eliminate code duplication between vendor parsers

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Config accepts MappingProxyType (frozen read-only mappings) without mutability assumptions
acceptance_criteria.gherkin: Given MappingProxyType config (as produced by SkillActivityConfig._freeze) When ClaudeHarnessConfig.from_mapping() is called Then parsing succeeds using .get() and membership checks only; no dict(config) copies; no isinstance(x, dict) checks that reject MappingProxyType
acceptance_criteria.jtbd: Accept frozen configs from activity loader

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Refactored logger accessor: generalized agent_log_path replaces devin_log_path
acceptance_criteria.gherkin: Given SkillActivityOutput with agent_log_path field When getters are called Then the path points to the harness-specific log file; common.workflow_logger exposes get_agent_logger()/get_agent_log_path() as generalized accessors; underlying file renamed to agent.log (not vendor-specific)
acceptance_criteria.jtbd: Provide harness-agnostic log path accessor

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Refactored trajectory accessor: generalized trajectory_path replaces atif_path
acceptance_criteria.gherkin: Given SkillActivityOutput with trajectory_path field When getters are called Then the path points to devin-trajectory.json or claude-trajectory.jsonl depending on which harness ran; both field names are available as harness-agnostic accessors
acceptance_criteria.jtbd: Provide harness-agnostic trajectory path accessor

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Usage metrics are populated for Claude (improvement over current Devin which returns None cost_usd)
acceptance_criteria.gherkin: Given a successful claude -p invocation When HarnessUsage is parsed Then cost_usd is populated from terminal result event (non-None), providing real cost visibility unlike current Devin implementation which always returns None
acceptance_criteria.jtbd: Capture real USD cost from Claude API usage

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Test coverage matches DevinHarness test suite parity
acceptance_criteria.gherkin: Given test_claude_harness.py When tests run Then all 11 test scenarios from test_devin_harness.py are covered: namespace isolation, successful run with usage, non-zero exit with partial usage, missing/truncated/malformed output, boolean rejection, logging sanitization, OSError handling, artifact directory isolation, HarnessResult structure, durable vs temporary trajectory, and read_claude_usage_result() unit tests
acceptance_criteria.jtbd: Ensure implementation completeness via test parity

edge_cases.criterion: Claude binary not found in PATH
edge_cases.gherkin: Given claude command not installed When subprocess.run() is called Then OSError is raised and caught, RuntimeError('claude_launch_failed') is raised to caller

edge_cases.criterion: NDJSON stream truncated or incomplete (subprocess killed mid-output)
edge_cases.gherkin: Given subprocess killed before result event is emitted When trajectory is parsed Then usage=None is returned; process exit_code is preserved; no exception is raised

edge_cases.criterion: NDJSON contains malformed JSON on one or more lines
edge_cases.gherkin: Given stream with unparseable line When read_claude_usage_result() parses Then error is caught; usage=None is returned; exit_code/stdout/stderr are unchanged

edge_cases.criterion: Terminal result event is missing from stream entirely
edge_cases.gherkin: Given NDJSON stream without result event When usage is extracted Then usage=None returned with error_category='missing_result_event'; process result preserved

edge_cases.criterion: Result event present but missing usage fields
edge_cases.gherkin: Given result event without usage object or with partial fields When HarnessUsage is constructed Then missing fields are treated as None; no exception is raised

edge_cases.criterion: Token counts presented as boolean instead of integer
edge_cases.gherkin: Given result event with prompt_tokens=true (boolean) When _token() coercion is applied Then boolean is rejected; field is set to None; related fields may succeed

edge_cases.criterion: Token counts are negative or very large numbers
edge_cases.gherkin: Given result event with negative or very large token counts When _token() coercion is applied Then numeric type is accepted (no rejection based on magnitude); value is stored as-is
edge_cases.jtbd: Accept numeric token counts regardless of magnitude

edge_cases.criterion: Config contains empty 'claude' block (no model, no permission_mode)
edge_cases.gherkin: Given config={'claude': {}} When ClaudeHarnessConfig.from_mapping() is called Then model defaults to secure model value; permission_mode defaults to 'dontAsk'
edge_cases.jtbd: Apply safe defaults to minimal config

edge_cases.criterion: Permission mode maps incorrectly between Devin and Claude naming
edge_cases.gherkin: Given Devin mode 'auto' (everything, no asking) is confused with Claude mode 'auto' (background classifier) When permission_mode is validated Then only Claude-native modes are accepted; Devin modes are rejected or require explicit migration
edge_cases.jtbd: Prevent mode confusion between harness vendors

edge_cases.criterion: Activity logging context is set but artifact directory is inaccessible or read-only
edge_cases.gherkin: Given get_activity_artifact_dir() returns read-only path When trajectory is written Then write fails; exception is caught; usage is still extracted and returned; exit_code/stdout/stderr preserved

edge_cases.criterion: Temporary directory creation fails (disk full, permissions denied)
edge_cases.gherkin: Given tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() raises exception When trajectory is parsed Then exception is caught; usage=None is returned; process result preserved

edge_cases.criterion: Skill prompt contains arguments that look like flags (starts with -)
edge_cases.gherkin: Given skill prompt text starting with '--' When run() constructs subprocess command Then prompt is passed after -- separator to prevent misinterpretation as CLI flags
edge_cases.jtbd: Prevent prompt text from being parsed as CLI flags

edge_cases.criterion: Skill prompt is extremely large (millions of characters)
edge_cases.gherkin: Given very large prompt text When passed to claude -p Then subprocess may hit command-line length limits; no special handling is added (same behavior as Devin)

edge_cases.criterion: Claude API rate limiting or quota exceeded during execution
edge_cases.gherkin: Given claude CLI hits rate limit When subprocess exits with error status Then exit_code is preserved; stdout contains CLI error message; usage may be None or partially extracted; no exception is raised

edge_cases.criterion: Authentication token (ANTHROPIC_API_KEY) is missing or invalid
edge_cases.gherkin: Given missing or invalid auth token When claude CLI is invoked Then subprocess exits with error; stdout/stderr contain auth error; exit_code is preserved; usage=None

edge_cases.criterion: Cost field is absent from terminal result event
edge_cases.gherkin: Given result event without total_cost_usd field When HarnessUsage is constructed Then cost_usd=None is returned; token counts may still be populated

questions.question: What exactly should HarnessResult.stdout contain: only the terminal result event's text field, or the full raw NDJSON blob?
questions.decision: Use full raw NDJSON output for richer content and complete trajectory access
impacts: HarnessResult contract and documentation
Downstream consumers of stdout (skill implementations, workflow debugging)
Trajectory availability (if stdout=NDJSON, trajectory already available; if stdout=text, full stream is separate)
API parity with Devin (whose stdout is plain text, not JSON)

questions.question: How should SkillActivity.execute() select which config namespace to read ('devin' vs 'claude') when multiple harnesses could be active, without requiring edits to every *.config.json file?
questions.decision: Create a Worker-level config that selects the relevant namespace and harness when SkillActivities are invoked; SkillActivity.execute() reads the selected harness class and uses it to determine which namespace to read from the config
impacts: Config file migration burden (do all files need a 'claude' block added, or can one harness be selected dynamically?)
SkillActivity.execute() coupling to harness class (need a way to know which namespace to read)
Multiple candidate solutions (§2.7 lists four) with different trade-offs on future extensibility

questions.question: Should --bare flag be used to suppress .claude/ skill/hook/MCP discovery during unattended skill-activity invocations, or will that break skill prompts that depend on project-level configuration?
impacts: Trust dialog handling (undiscovered dialogs could block non-interactive runs)
Skill prompt content and dependencies (some skills may need .claude/ config to resolve correctly)
Safety vs functionality trade-off (fail closed with --bare, or trust skill prompts are self-contained?)

questions.question: Is per-message usage in --output-format stream-json cumulative across the session (like ATIF's pattern), or per-turn deltas (like standard Anthropic Messages API)?
impacts: Usage extraction logic (if cumulative, take final event; if deltas, must sum all events)
Test validation (need real multi-turn trace to confirm assumption)
Accuracy of token/cost reporting (if wrong assumption, totals could be N× off for N-turn sessions)

questions.question: Should raw trajectory NDJSON be retained by default (like ATIF's ADR-015 recommendation), or is the plain result event sufficient for audit?
questions.decision: Retain raw trajectory NDJSON the same way Devin ATIF is retained — written to the activity's process subfolder for indefinite retention, following ADR-015 pattern
impacts: Audit trail completeness (full per-step stream vs aggregate result only)
Storage overhead (NDJSON can be significantly larger than ATIF steps array)
Compliance/retention requirements (do full transcripts need to be kept indefinitely?)

questions.question: Does renaming devin_log_path→agent_log_path in story-analysis-report-v1.schema.json require a version bump to v2, or can it be an in-place migration?
impacts: Existing report artifacts that validate against v1 schema
Schema version management and migration tooling
Backward compatibility requirements for archived reports

questions.question: Are there any skill prompts in .claude/skills/ or elsewhere that depend on project-level Claude Code configuration (.claude/) being loaded, or are all skill prompts self-contained text?
impacts: Safety of --bare flag default (§2.2)
Scope of skill prompt dependencies
Whether configuration needs to be passed through to claude CLI or not

questions.question: Should --no-session-persistence be added to avoid accumulating ~/.claude/projects/ transcripts in CI/worker environments, or are those transcripts desired for audit?
impacts: Disk usage in CI (accumulated transcripts per invocation across all workflows)
Audit trail retention (are project-level transcripts part of compliance requirements?)
Local development behavior (does --no-session-persistence change behavior in local vs CI?)

questions.question: What are the confirmed field names for prompt/completion/cached token counts and cost in the terminal result event returned by --output-format stream-json?
impacts: Usage parsing implementation (read_claude_usage_result hardcoding)
Documentation and field mapping
Compatibility if Claude CLI field names change in future versions

questions.question: When SkillActivity.execute() reports model/permission_mode to observation dict, should it read from the config, from the harness instance, or from some other source of truth?
impacts: Config-namespace coupling in SkillActivity
Observation dict accuracy (reported mode should match what was actually used)
Harness-agnostic access to configuration parameters

Decision on config namespace selection mechanism (§4, open question 5) - blocks SkillActivity.execute() updates
Verification that --bare flag is safe or alternative approach if not (§4, open question 4)
blocks: Any workflow/skill that wants to use Claude CLI instead of Devin
Cost reporting improvements (Claude provides real USD cost, unlike Devin)
Multi-vendor harness strategy and extensibility patterns
